# fjordrun_team_invites (Data Source)

A team's pending invites. Needs the admin role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_team_invites" "pending" {
  team_id = var.team_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `invites` (Attributes List) The invites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `email` (String) Email.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry.
- `id` (String) Invite ID.
- `role` (String) Role.
